title: Preflight notes: runtime + console weekly sync
body:
Goal: quick alignment before the 30m team sync. Capture context, questions, and concrete takeaways to hand off after the meeting.

Quick numbers to have ready (pull from perf dashboard pre-meeting):
- Prod p95 gen latency: ~142ms (model x-13, 2k tokens), trend +8% week-over-week
- Token-cost/unit: estimated $0.0023 (hosted); note outlier spikes Mar 6-8 during Canary
- Dedicated pool utilization: 68% steady, short bursts to 92% at 11:30 PST on Tue

Main agenda (20m):
1) Rollout status: kernel-selection experiment (INF-4212) — safety checks + canary results (Priya) (5m)
   - Key ask: confirm canary latency tail behavior under 8k seqs.
   - Risk note: small sample on dedicated, need wider traffic slice before bumping to 50%.
2) Console telemetry gaps — missing per-route cache-hit metrics (Carlos) (5m)
   - Where values show NaN in the token-level chart: probable ingestion mapping bug.
   - Ask: ETA for ingestion fix + retroactive recalculation window?
3) Fallback routing policy: observed 3 incidents where fallback didn't trigger (Ethan) (5m)
   - Hypothesis: policy mismatch for model variant labels. Bring concrete request for policy rule tests.
4) Ops calendar + upcoming infra maintenance (me) (3m)
   - Plan: schedule 2-hour window 03/20 for driver updates; customer notice needed if Dedicated used heavily.
5) AOB & quick action assignment (2m)

My personal prep notes / prompts to call out:
- Ask Priya whether kernel-selection has new perf tests for repeated short sequences (50-200 tokens) — those are app-critical.
- Confirm Carlos can add a temporary synthetic metric for cache hits (push to /metrics/temp-cache-hit) so we can alert on regression during rollout.
- For fallback incidents: request full trace ids + request re-run of policy evaluation against the exact request batch. If Ethan can drop those in INF-4212 comments, I'll pull them into a quick replay job.
- Note to self: update runbook step 4 to include metric name change from token_cache_hit -> prefix_cache_hit (open PR in infra/playbooks).
- Prep 2 slides (1) short results from canary, (2) proposed rollout schedule + rollback criteria. Keep slides minimal.

Action items (to be tracked in sync notes):
- Priya: post canary raw tails + seq-length breakdown to INF-4212 by 2026-03-13.
- Carlos: temporary synthetic metric + ETA for ingestion fix by 2026-03-14.
- Ethan: attach traces from the three fallback incidents to INF-4212 and add quick repro steps by 2026-03-13.
- Samira (me): draft customer-facing note for Dedicated maintenance and route to CS for review by 2026-03-15.
- All: review the proposed rollback criteria doc (link in INF-4212 comments) and leave +1 or concerns before 2026-03-14.

Follow-up format I want after sync (one-paragraph email / slack summary):
- What shipped or agreed (1-2 bullets), owners + firm due dates for action items, any blockers that require escalation, and next sync topics called out.

Open questions / decisions pending (to push during meeting):
- Is 50% traffic for kernel selection safe given current sample size? (need engineering sign-off + perf regression window length)
- Can we get a one-off retroactive calculation for cache-hit for last 7 days? If not, what's the closest substitute?

Privacy / comms note: if rollback needed during business hours, ops should coordinate with CS and Plaintiff accounts list (use escalation list in playbook). Keep messaging short and technical.

Scratch reminders (private):
- After meeting: add two quick tests to local perf harness: long-seq 8k and many-short 64 token microbursts.
- Follow up with infra on node-reboot schedule, vendor driver version locked at 520.61 or later.
- Remove debug-level logging for kv-cache in prod (spikes token count on logs) — open PR reference: runtimes#789 (WIP).

End of notes. Will convert action items into a Jira subtask list after the meeting and ping collaborators for confirmations.
action_items: Priya: post canary raw tails + seq-length breakdown to INF-4212 by 2026-03-13
Carlos: create synthetic metric + ETA for ingestion fix by 2026-03-14
Ethan: attach traces for fallback incidents to INF-4212 by 2026-03-13
Samira: draft Dedicated maintenance customer note by 2026-03-15
All: review rollback criteria doc and comment by 2026-03-14
